author.name: Semi Erendönmez
credits: Octatrack module and DSP56300 code by Semi Erendönmez
Tempo division after octabam's BusDelay and the line's bounded clear after octabam's Mini Verb (Sam Banks, MIT); the noise generator follows Analog BD's LCG idiom

presentation.label: LOSSY TEMPO ECHO
presentation.summary: An echo on the tempo whose repeats pass through a lossy codec every time: darker, coarser and more broken as they fade, with packets lost and concealed.
presentation.overview: CODEC ECHO is a tempo-synced echo (1/32 to 1/2, with triplets and dotted values) on a 1.44 s line that runs at half the rate in 12 bits. Every repeat passes through the codec again: LOSS codes it with ADPCM at 5, 4, 3 or 2 bits a sample (G.726's depths) and darkens it, and DROP loses packets of PKT's length, concealed by silence or by repeating the packet before (PLC). FDBK sets how much comes back, up to 0.95. MIX 0 returns the dry bit for bit.
highlights: Tempo-synced echo, 1/32 to 1/2 with triplets and dotted values
Every repeat through ADPCM again, 5 down to 2 bits a sample, and darker
Lost packets concealed by silence or a repeat
TIME and tempo changes move the echo without a click
usage: On an audio track, hold FUNC and press FX2, turn LEVEL to CODEC ECHO and press YES.
Turn MIX up on the main page; TIME picks the division, FDBK the repeats, LOSS how lossy each repeat gets, DROP and PKT the lost packets.
FX2 SETUP holds PLC: MUTE leaves a hole where a packet is lost, RPT repeats the packet before. Turn MIX to 0 for the dry.

controls.name: TIME
controls.doc: The echo's time, a note division of the tempo

controls.name: FDBK
controls.doc: How much of each echo comes back, up to 0.95

controls.name: LOSS
controls.doc: The codec: ADPCM at 5, 4, 3 or 2 bits, and darker, every pass

controls.name: DROP
controls.doc: The chance a packet is lost, up to one in two

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: The echoes over the dry; 0 = the dry, untouched

controls.name: PLC
controls.doc: A lost packet: silence, or the packet before it again

limitations: FX2 only, and needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta) with an effect id of its own; the card builds' non-stock ids are all claimed but 0x07, which the draft holds as a placeholder.
The line takes 15,870 words of the FX2 slot's buffer and stops short of Sidechain Compressor's key window. For about 0.05 s after the effect is chosen it clears the line and passes the dry.
TIME follows the tempo word octabam's BusDelay reads at r6+$13; a division longer than 1.44 s halves until it fits. Swing and track speed do not change the echo.
The echo is mono, mixed over the stereo dry. The codec is lossy at every setting, on purpose: its noise and, at 2 bits, its failure on high tones show in fx:audit (TESTING.md).

Only reported by the developer to run on their own Octatrack MKI from a card build (31 Oct 2026; the exact revision was not recorded); otherwise run only in fxhost (the vendored DSP56300 emulator alone), not under the ColdFire port.

storage.label: DSP program / table / buffer
storage.conditions: dsp_asm: the program words and one 12-word P table per core (TESTING.md). 41 state words in each instance's own r7 block. 15,870 words of the allocator's FX2 Y buffer per instance.

processing.label: DSP instruction peak
processing.conditions: fxhost (dsp56kEmu alone), one instance, 16-frame calls at the dearest settings: 3,130 instructions a call. Executed instructions, not chip cycles; not yet measured beside stock SPRING REV in dsp_host.

impact.conditions: One instance at its dearest settings.

cpu.rationale: No ColdFire code: a cloned effect descriptor; the stock pages publish the knobs.

dsp.rationale: About two thirds of the 314 instructions a sample octabam's benchmark reports for stock SPRING REV, in fxhost; not measured under the same benchmark.

memory.rationale: A whole FX2 slot's buffer (15,870 of 16,384 words) per instance, as stock's reverbs; 533 program words and a 206-word table.

tests.summary: fxhost only (the vendored dsp56kEmu with the module alone, no firmware): MIX 0 is the dry bit for bit from garbage state with trig splits; a garbage line is never heard; the echo starts 10 samples after its division at four tempos; repeats decay with FDBK and reach digital silence; the ADPCM's signal-to-noise ratio falls from 49 to 24 dB from 5 to 2 bits and adapts to the level; LOSS darkens; DROP leaves holes of PKT's length and RPT none; a TIME change makes no click; nothing outside the audio, state, parameter and line words is written. Not run under the ColdFire port; reported by the developer to run on their own Octatrack MKI from a card build (31 Oct 2026; the exact revision was not recorded).

license.declaration: Original DSP56300 code by Semi Erendönmez, GPL-3.0-or-later. No Elektron firmware, extracted routines, tables, samples or dumps are included; no stock table is read.

access.location: Audio track FX2 SETUP: CODEC ECHO in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 to open FX2 SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to CODEC ECHO and press YES; PLC appears on the SETUP page.
Press FX2 for the main page: TIME, FDBK, LOSS, DROP, PKT and MIX.
